text:
sophia: Hey folks — moving out next weekend, offering a Bose soundbar (works fine, small dent on the back) and a black tuxedo accent chair (fabric, wooden legs removable). Curbside pickup SF SOMA only. Pics: https://img.example.com/soundbar1974.jpg and https://img.example.com/chair1974.jpg. DM to claim.

anish: Interested in the soundbar. Does it have optical or HDMI ARC? Battery for remote?

sophia: Optical + AUX, no HDMI ARC. Remote included (uses AAA). Bluetooth pairs ok.

liam: Chair dimensions? Will it fit in a sedan?

sophia: About 28" wide, 30" deep, legs unscrew so it fits in most hatchbacks/sedans with seats folded.

marcus: If chair still free, I can grab Tue after 6pm.

jenny: I can take the soundbar on Sun afternoon. @sophia should I add it to the pickup calendar? I can bring a spare box for protection.

sophia: Jenny you're first for the soundbar 44d Please book a 30min slot on the "Curbside Pickups" calendar and leave a sticky note with your name on the item.

logistics-bot: Reminder: All curbside pickups require a calendar booking and visitor sign-in per policy: https://company.example.com/office-pickups. Leave items at the lobby table with a visible name tag.

anish: If Jenny bails, I'm still available Wed evening.

sophia: Will do the calendar note. If anything changes Ill update here. Leaving both items at curb 4pm Sat if not claimed.

liam: You're a legend, @sophia 389 Good luck with the move!

sophia: Thanks everyone :)
